summary: Frontend-only testing of Teologia Viva PWA. Auth page renders correctly. However signup creates account but returns NO session because the Supabase project has email confirmation ENABLED. Login fails with 'email_not_confirmed'. This blocks every authenticated feature (Inicio, Academia, Curso, Aula, Biblia, Comunidade, Eventos, Anotacoes, Perfil, AI tutor, AI rate limit, plan logic). Also found `profiles` table schema is missing the `plano` column and RLS denies SELECT for anon role; the app's synthetic-profile fallback would mask this if a session existed, but no session is ever created.

ui_bugs.issue: Email confirmation is enabled in Supabase Auth settings. signUp returns user but session=null, so Protected routes immediately redirect back to /auth. Subsequent signIn returns 400 {code: 'email_not_confirmed'}. End-to-end testing of ALL authenticated features is blocked.

PGRST204 — Could not find the 'plano' column of 'profiles' in the schema cache. Upsert on signup fails with 400. App has synthetic-profile fallback so UI wouldn't crash once a session exists, but the schema must still match app expectations (plano, trial_inicio, nome, email).

SELECT on profiles returns 401 {code: '42501', 'permission denied for table profiles'}. Hint: GRANT SELECT ON public.profiles TO anon; (or authenticated). Fallback masks it but prevents real profile (plan, nome) from ever loading.

integration_issues.issue: After signUp, navigate('/') runs but Protected sees user=null (because Supabase returned session=null due to email confirmation requirement) and redirects back to /auth. A green success toast 'Conta criada — seu trial de 7 dias começou' appears but the user is stuck on /auth.
Fails 400 email_not_confirmed. UI shows a red toast but then stays on /auth with empty fields — no explicit guidance that email needs to be confirmed.

action_items: CRITICAL: In Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → Providers → Email, DISABLE 'Confirm email' for this project (or enable auto-confirm), so signUp immediately returns a session. Without this, the whole product is unusable end-to-end and no testing agent can proceed.

Add the missing `plano` column (text, default 'trial') to public.profiles. Also ensure columns: id uuid PK, nome text, email text, trial_inicio timestamptz, trial_fim timestamptz (optional). Re-check the upsert payload in AuthContext.jsx against the real schema.

Add RLS policy: `GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.profiles TO authenticated;` and a policy like `CREATE POLICY "users read own profile" ON public.profiles FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);` plus a matching insert/update policy. Currently anon/authenticated are denied.

After fixing the three items above, re-run this iteration to validate signup → trial badge → devocional → Academia → Biblia → Comunidade → Eventos → Anotacoes → Perfil → Tutor IA → Free plan lock on lesson 2+ → 5 AI calls/day rate limit.
Nice-to-have: when signIn fails with 'email_not_confirmed', show a clearer PT-BR toast like 'Confirme seu email antes de entrar' and optionally a 'Reenviar email de confirmação' button.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx: signUp's silent `try { upsert } catch {}` swallows errors but the upsert actually returns a 400 JSON (not a thrown exception) from supabase-js v2. The failed upsert is logged to the console as `Failed to load resource 400`. Consider awaiting and checking `error` property and logging a clearer warning.

AuthContext.jsx: when Supabase returns session=null (email-confirm flow), signUp resolves successfully and Auth.jsx calls navigate('/'), but Protected redirects back. UX bug — detect `!data.session` and show a message like 'Verifique seu email para concluir o cadastro' instead of navigating.
No guard against stale tokens or expired trial computation on the frontend — plan.js was not inspected end-to-end but should be reviewed once the auth blocker is unblocked.

Frontend `.env` holds the Supabase anon key in plaintext (expected for client), but do add `REACT_APP_` prefixing consistency check. All keys are present (REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL, REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY).

success_rate.frontend: 0% of authenticated flows (blocked at auth). Auth page UI renders correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The three Supabase-side fixes MUST land before any feature test can run. Once they do, sign up a fresh email like qatest+<ts>@gmail.com and the app should navigate to '/', show [data-testid=plan-badge] containing 'Trial · 7d', render [data-testid=devocional-card] (or a fallback message if no devocional for CURRENT_DATE). Then walk the 5 bottom-nav tabs, then /anotacoes, /perfil, /curso/:id, /aula/:id. Use viewport 420x844. The edge function POST ${REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/clever-task with {prompt} body was not reachable in this run because no session existed to authorize it.
rca of the issue: 1) `POST /auth/v1/signup` returns 200 with user object but **no session** (because Supabase project has 'Confirm email' enabled). AuthProvider.signUp therefore never populates `user`, so when Auth.jsx calls `navigate('/')`, Protected sees `user=null` and redirects straight back to /auth. 2) `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password` returns 400 `{code:'email_not_confirmed'}` on subsequent login. 3) Independently, the `profiles` upsert returns 400 `PGRST204 Could not find the 'plano' column` and GET returns 401 `42501 permission denied for table profiles`. Reproduction: open /auth, tab 'Criar conta', enter a unique email + nome + senha >=6 chars, click 'Começar trial de 7 dias' → green success toast but URL stays /auth. Mitigation: (a) disable email confirmation in Supabase, (b) add `plano text default 'trial'` and sibling columns to public.profiles, (c) add RLS + GRANT for authenticated role.
